title: 水平定向鑽掘導向~Horizontal directional drilling guidance
focus: 定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距~Directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance
summary: 本課以定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距為主線，從鑽桿長度與垂向投影與方位誤差與橫向漂移建立系統邊界，再把磁場干擾與方位可信度、設施淨距與不確定度連到竣工閉合與全線可信度。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance. It begins with Rod length and vertical projection and Heading error and lateral drift, links Magnetic interference and heading confidence and Utility clearance and uncertainty, and ends with As-built closure and route confidence. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影~Rod length and vertical projection
units.title: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影~Rod length and vertical projection
units.mechanism: 鑽進長度沿實際路徑量取，垂向變化由傾角投影決定而非直接等於桿長。分段積分需保留角度正負與參考方向，彎曲段還需考慮角度在桿內的變化；一個末端傾角不能代表整段平均姿態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合；若出現把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Drilled length follows the actual path, while vertical change comes from inclination projection rather than rod length itself. Segment integration requires signed angles and reference direction, with curvature changing attitude within a rod. One endpoint inclination cannot automatically represent the segment-average attitude. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure. If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 鑽桿末端傾角一定等於整根鑽桿的平均傾角~The rod-end inclination always equals the mean inclination of the whole rod

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 方位誤差與橫向漂移~Heading error and lateral drift
units.title: 方位誤差與橫向漂移~Heading error and lateral drift
units.mechanism: 微小方位偏差沿距離累積成顯著橫向漂移，固定偏差與隨機噪聲的統計行為不同。直線投影可估單一偏差的量級，真正路線需要逐段姿態積分；不能把多次讀值平均當成對磁北或控制網的獨立校核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較重複方位讀值與獨立測量控制的方向差；若出現固定方位偏差被當隨機誤差平均，長距離後仍偏離走廊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Small heading bias accumulates into substantial lateral drift, unlike zero-mean random noise. Straight projection estimates one fixed-bias effect, while real routes require segmentwise attitude integration. Averaging repeated readings does not independently verify the magnetic reference or survey control network. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare repeated headings with independently surveyed control directions. If a fixed heading bias is treated as random noise and the long route still leaves its corridor, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. units.anchor: 曲率半徑與角度單位~Curvature radius and angular units
units.title: 曲率半徑與角度單位~Curvature radius and angular units
units.mechanism: 相鄰姿態角差與弧長決定局部曲率，但角度需轉成弧度才可直接使用半徑關係。鑽具和成品管各有不同彎曲限制，短距姿態噪聲會製造假小半徑；路徑平滑不能刪除真實局部折角的證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對相鄰姿態、測距及獨立管材彎曲要求；若出現把度數直接當弧度使半徑低估數十倍，導致錯誤判讀，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Local curvature relates arc length to attitude change, with radians required in the radius relation. Drill string and product pipe have different bending constraints, and short-baseline attitude noise can create falsely tight curvature. Smoothing the path must not erase evidence of a real localized dogleg. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare adjacent attitudes and distances with separately established pipe-bending requirements. If using degrees directly as radians understates radius by a large factor and distorts interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 工具面與地層轉向反應~Toolface and ground steering response
units.title: 工具面與地層轉向反應~Toolface and ground steering response
units.mechanism: 工具面方向設定與實際軌跡轉向之間受地層、鑽頭和桿件彈性影響，並非固定一比一。觀察到的轉向增益僅適用該段與該工況，交替地層可能改變幅度和延遲；應先識別回應再談模型是否可信。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程；若出現沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Toolface orientation does not translate one-to-one into route turning because ground, bit and rod elasticity intervene. Observed steering gain belongs to the specific segment and state; changing layers alter magnitude and delay. Identify the response before treating a steering model as transferable. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare toolface records and measured attitude changes against geological transitions. If reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 磁場干擾與方位可信度~Magnetic interference and heading confidence
units.title: 磁場干擾與方位可信度~Magnetic interference and heading confidence
units.mechanism: 磁導向依賴地磁向量，埋設鋼材、電流及鄰近設施會改變局部場。簡單橫向擾動模型可顯示方位敏感度，但傾角補償與三維磁異常需另評估；總磁場強度接近正常也不能保證方向不偏。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據；若出現局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Magnetic guidance depends on the field vector, disturbed by buried steel, electrical currents and nearby structures. A simple transverse perturbation illustrates heading sensitivity, while tilt compensation and three-dimensional anomalies require separate assessment. A near-normal field magnitude does not prove an unbiased field direction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. If local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 陀螺漂移與時間校核~Gyro drift and time checks
units.title: 陀螺漂移與時間校核~Gyro drift and time checks
units.mechanism: 陀螺可避免部分磁干擾，但零偏會隨積分時間累積，溫度和振動又可能改變偏差。恆定漂移假設適合看時間敏感度，不保證實際誤差線性；獨立起始方位與週期校核需連到每段資料的時間戳。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照陀螺溫度、時間戳與獨立方位閉合差；若出現重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A gyro avoids some magnetic disturbance, but bias accumulates with integration time and can vary with temperature and vibration. Constant drift illustrates time sensitivity without guaranteeing linear real error. Independent initial heading and periodic checks must be linked to each segment timestamp. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare gyro temperature and timestamps with independent heading-closure error. If reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：angleDrift=0.02 degree/h*0.5 h=0.010 degree; finalAngleProjection=200 m*tan(0.010 degree)=0.0349 m assuming the final angle applies over the entire length; not a time-integrated guidance path error。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: angleDrift=0.02 degree/h*0.5 h=0.010 degree; finalAngleProjection=200 m*tan(0.010 degree)=0.0349 m assuming the final angle applies over the entire length; not a time-integrated guidance path error. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 對照陀螺溫度、時間戳與獨立方位閉合差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare gyro temperature and timestamps with independent heading-closure error. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照陀螺溫度、時間戳與獨立方位閉合差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare gyro temperature and timestamps with independent heading-closure error to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 陀螺不受磁場影響就代表永遠不會產生方位誤差~A gyro immune to magnetic interference never develops heading error
units.practice: 將對照陀螺溫度、時間戳與獨立方位閉合差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare gyro temperature and timestamps with independent heading-closure error. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 設施淨距與不確定度~Utility clearance and uncertainty
units.title: 設施淨距與不確定度~Utility clearance and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 地下設施的中心線位置、外徑和調查精度都影響真正淨距，圖上中心距不是可用安全間隔。不確定度扣減需明示保守或統計規則，還要扣除兩者尺寸；未知設施不能因地圖空白就視為不存在。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度；若出現只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~True utility clearance depends on centerline location, outside dimensions and survey uncertainty; map center distance is not available separation. State conservative or statistical uncertainty rules and subtract both object dimensions. A blank map does not establish that unknown services are absent from the route. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. If comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 環空輸送與孔內壓力~Annular transport and bore pressure
units.title: 環空輸送與孔內壓力~Annular transport and bore pressure
units.mechanism: 環空流速由流量和淨流通面積決定，偏心、岩屑床與非牛頓流變會改變局部速度及壓損。平均流速不能單獨證明孔壁穩定或不會冒漿；導向紀錄需與返流及壓力資料共同解釋地層反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置；若出現岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Annular velocity follows flow and available area, while eccentricity, cuttings beds and non-Newtonian rheology change local speed and loss. Mean velocity alone proves neither wall stability nor freedom from inadvertent returns. Interpret guidance with return-flow and pressure evidence to understand ground response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. If a cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((0.60 m)^2-(0.40 m)^2)/4=0.1571 m2; meanVelocity=0.020 m3/s/0.1571 m2=0.1273 m/s。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((0.60 m)^2-(0.40 m)^2)/4=0.1571 m2; meanVelocity=0.020 m3/s/0.1571 m2=0.1273 m/s. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

units.anchor: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變~Pullback bending and axial strain
units.title: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變~Pullback bending and axial strain
units.mechanism: 成品管沿孔道曲率彎曲，回拖張力再疊加軸向應變，最外纖維可能成為控制位置。小應變線彈性相加需使用一致材料模量，熱塑管的時間與溫度行為不能直接套鋼材；實際孔徑和摩擦仍影響回拖荷載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能；若出現鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The product pipe bends along bore curvature while pullback tension adds axial strain, potentially governing the outer fiber. Small-strain elastic addition requires consistent modulus; thermoplastic time and temperature behavior cannot be replaced by steel assumptions. Actual bore geometry and friction also affect pullback loading. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. If applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

units.anchor: 竣工閉合與全線可信度~As-built closure and route confidence
units.title: 竣工閉合與全線可信度~As-built closure and route confidence
units.mechanism: 終點閉合誤差是整段測量的一項約束，不能保證中途每個位置正確；相反方向偏差可能在終點互相抵消。全線成果需保留逐桿原始資料、校正和獨立控制，並把位置不確定度沿路徑呈現。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對；若出現中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Endpoint closure constrains the survey but does not prove every intermediate position, because opposing errors can cancel at the end. Preserve raw rod-by-rod data, corrections and independent control. Present uncertainty along the route rather than interpreting one endpoint residual as a universal error bound. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare endpoint closure with intermediate independent control points and rod-by-rod data. If opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查鑽桿長度與垂向投影：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m；再獨立檢查方位誤差與橫向漂移：lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m。方向誤差由 0.1 增至 0.2 度，在 100 m 直段上橫向差約由 0.175 增至 0.349 m；系統誤差不能靠增加相同來源讀值消除。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 將對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Rod length and vertical projection: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m. Independently check Heading error and lateral drift: lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m. Increasing heading error from 0.1 to 0.2 degree raises lateral offset over a 100 m straight segment from about 0.175 to 0.349 m; repeating the same biased source does not remove systematic error. The two results are not a complete design because guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. Use compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，並說明導向感測與磁場干擾；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling and describes guidance sensing and magnetic interference. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
